description: TDK InvenSense MPU-6050 — 6-axis motion-tracking IC with 3-axis MEMS gyroscope (±250 to ±2000 °/s) and 3-axis MEMS accelerometer (±2 to ±16 g), 16-bit ADCs, on-chip DMP (Digital Motion Processor) for sensor fusion, I²C interface up to 400 kHz, QFN-24 4×4 mm. The most-used maker IMU by a wide margin — drones, gimbals, segway-bots, gesture controllers, head trackers. Officially obsoleted by InvenSense in favor of MPU-6500/9250 but still widely cloned and stocked.
name: mpu6050
watch_out_for: VLOGIC (pin 8) MUST be tied to VDD (3.3 V) or an I²C bus voltage — not left floating, or I²C won't respond. AD0 (pin 9) selects I²C address: tied LOW = 0x68, tied HIGH = 0x69 — most breakouts hard-tie this to GND. NOT 5 V tolerant — needs 3.3 V supply AND 3.3 V-level SDA/SCL (use a level shifter if your host is 5 V). INT (pin 12) is push-pull or open-drain (configurable via register 0x37). REGOUT (pin 10) is internally generated 1.8 V — add the 10 nF cap, do not load externally. Many counterfeit dies in the wild: if WHO_AM_I (reg 0x75) returns 0x71 instead of 0x68 it's an MPU-6500 die in MPU-6050 marking. The on-die DMP firmware load is undocumented but Jeff Rowberg's I2Cdev / Drotek code works.
